    The competency-based framework

    A correct answer does not
    guarantee deep understanding.

    Bloom's Taxonomy defines 6 levels of cognitive complexity — from basic recall to original creation. Most school assessments only test Levels 1 and 2. SIYA analyses all six — giving your leadership team visibility into the depth of learning across every classroom.

    L6
    Create
    —
    Design · Construct
    28%
    L5
    Evaluate
    —
    Judge · Critique · Defend
    35%
    L4

    Break down · Compare · Infer
    41%
    L3
    Apply
    —
    Use · Solve · Execute
    52%
    L2
    Understand
    —
    Explain · Summarise · Classify
    71%
    L1
    Remember
    —
    Recall · Recognise · List
    89%
    🤖
    SIYA maps every student response to a Bloom's level — automatically — giving your school leadership a cognitive-depth profile across every class, subject, and term.
    Why competency-based assessment matters

    Traditional assessments measure what students remember. Competency-based frameworks measure what students can do — analyse, evaluate, create. NEP 2020 mandates this shift. SIYA makes it measurable.

    What SIYA reveals beyond marks
